svg.title: Two runs of one entrypoint
svg.desc: Five lifelines: your code, the workflow entrypoint, the double task, the ask_human task, and the checkpointer. Run 1: invoke with 1, 2, 3 runs the bodies of double three times, saves the results 2, 4, and 6, calls ask_human with 12, and stops with the interrupt Keep it. Run 2: Command resume yes runs workflow again from its top. The double calls return the saved results 2, 4, and 6 and no body runs. ask_human gets yes, and workflow returns total 12 and answer yes.
